title: My Family
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Families differ: a child who lives with a grandparent or guardian names the people who care for him or her.

skills.key_step: The child names members of the nuclear and extended family and says a family worships and helps together (Acts 10:2).

floor.question: Name a member of your family.

steps: Name members of the extended family.
Say how families help each other.

board.do: Write a family tree with a blank for grandparents.
Wait for the child to say grandparents.

misconceptions.ask: Is your neighbour part of your extended family?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the family tree. Neighbours are not on it, though we love them.

misconceptions.ask: Your grandmother lives in the village. Is she your family?
misconceptions.repair: Put grandparents on the tree above parents.

misconceptions.ask: According to Acts 10:2, who worshipped God with Cornelius?

misconceptions.repair: Trace the line on the tree from uncle to his daughter.

checks.question: Name a member of the extended family.

skills.key_step: The child states items a family shares and four that should not be shared because they carry germs.
representations: two boxes: share, do not share
steps: Sort into share and do not share.
Say why some are not shared.

board.do: Write two columns: share, do not share.
Wait for the child to say do not share.

misconceptions.repair: Say: some things carry germs from mouth to mouth. Kindness is giving your sibling his own.

misconceptions.ask: Can a family share one razor blade?
misconceptions.repair: Show the "never share" list. Blood can carry diseases.
Sort into share (food, chairs) and do not share (toothbrush, towel).

misconceptions.ask: Is a bathing towel shared or not?
misconceptions.repair: A towel touches the body and can pass skin infections.

checks.question: Name an item that should not be shared.
Name an item a family shares.
